name: CJ Rivas
title: Staff Frontend Engineer + Architect
summary: Staff Frontend Engineer and Architect with 20 years of experience shipping consumer products at national scale. Deep specialization in React, TypeScript, and Next.js, with hands-on depth in AI-powered product experiences: LLM integrations, streaming UIs, MCP tooling, and agentic workflows. Has led frontend teams, mentored engineers at every level, and owned products end to end, from architecture and design systems through full-stack delivery and production operations.
skill_descriptions: A strongly typed superset of JavaScript that adds static type checking and modern language features. Essential for scaling large codebases, improving editor tooling, and catching bugs at compile time.
A component-based library for building declarative user interfaces. Uses a virtual DOM and hooks-based composition to manage state and side effects with predictable rendering.

Building AI-powered product experiences in production: LLM integrations, retrieval-augmented generation, streaming UIs, Model Context Protocol tooling, and agentic workflows. Pairs prompt engineering and evals with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor in daily development.
A React meta-framework with server-side rendering, file-based routing, and full-stack capabilities. Optimized for performance via the App Router, React Server Components, and edge deployment.
A progressive JavaScript framework featuring a reactive data model and single-file components. Balances approachable templating with a powerful composition API for scalable apps.
JavaScript runtime built on V8 for high-performance, event-driven server applications. Enables fullstack JS, CLI tooling, and scalable I/O with a vast npm ecosystem.

Building and maintaining design systems: reusable component libraries, design tokens, and documentation developed in isolation with Storybook. Ensures visual consistency, accessibility, and delivery speed across teams and products.
Architecting large applications as independently deployed frontends composed at runtime via Module Federation. Enables autonomous teams, incremental migrations, and isolated release cycles.

Modern component styling with utility-first Tailwind and CSS-in-JS via Emotion and Styled Components. Enables theme-aware, type-safe, design-token-driven styles that ship only the CSS actually in use.

Predictable state containers for managing application data outside React's component tree. Redux centralizes via actions and reducers; Zustand offers a leaner hooks-first store with minimal boilerplate.

Modern bundlers that transform, optimize, and serve JavaScript modules for production. Vite leverages native ESM for instant dev startup, while Webpack and Rollup excel at advanced bundling and tree-shaking.
Managing multi-package codebases with task orchestration, remote caching, and affected-only builds. Keeps shared libraries, apps, and design systems versioned and shipping together.
Unit, integration, and end-to-end testing with rich assertions, mocking, snapshots, and real-browser automation. Validates everything from pure functions to full user journeys before each deploy.
A query language and runtime for APIs where clients request exactly the data they need. Enables typed, schema-first contracts between frontends and backends with efficient, aggregated fetching.
Server-state management for React that handles fetching, caching, and background synchronization. Eliminates hand-rolled loading states with declarative queries, mutations, and cache invalidation.
TypeScript-first schema validation with static type inference. Validates API responses, forms, and configuration at runtime while keeping compile-time types perfectly in sync.
A type-safe ORM for Node.js with declarative schemas and generated migrations. Bridges application code and SQL databases with autocompleted, fully typed queries.
Decoupled content platforms that serve structured content to any frontend over APIs. Covers schema modeling, editorial workflow customization, and real-time collaborative publishing.
Cross-platform React targeting iOS, Android, web, and desktop from a single codebase. Expo layers on managed builds, over-the-air updates, and native APIs without leaving TypeScript.
An open-source Postgres backend with auth, storage, realtime, and edge functions. A fast path from schema to production for full-stack TypeScript applications.
Backend logic deployed as managed functions in the cloud or at the CDN edge. Scales to zero, deploys with the frontend, and keeps latency close to the user.
Profiling and optimizing for Core Web Vitals: LCP, INP, and CLS. Covers bundle analysis, code splitting, image and font strategies, and real-user monitoring to keep experiences fast at scale.
Instrumenting frontends with distributed tracing, error tracking, and real-user metrics via OpenTelemetry and tools like Sentry. Turns production behavior into actionable signals.
Hardening frontends against XSS, CSRF, and supply-chain attacks with Content Security Policy, Trusted Types, and OWASP practices. Treats security as a design constraint, not a patch.
Progressive delivery with feature flags, A/B experiments, and staged rollouts. Decouples deploy from release and lets product decisions be driven by measured user impact.
Interfaces built to WCAG standards: semantic markup, keyboard navigation, ARIA, and screen-reader support. Treats accessibility as a baseline of quality, not an afterthought.

achievements: Founded and operate an incorporated software practice, delivering senior and lead-level frontend engagements to clients across news, finance, real estate, telecom, and enterprise SaaS while running a continuous self-directed product and R&D track alongside them.

Design and ship full products end to end, from data modelling and API design through frontend architecture, design systems, testing, CI/CD, and production deployment, working primarily in React, Next.js App Router with React Server Components, and strict TypeScript.

Use Supabase as the default backend, standardizing on Postgres with row level security, auth, and edge functions, and keeping schema migrations version-controlled alongside application code so environments stay reproducible.

Work as an agentic developer, decomposing features into specifications and executable plans, then driving them through coding agents in small, reviewable increments with tests as the contract and every diff reviewed line by line before it lands.

Build the harness that makes agentic development safe on real codebases: committed convention files, custom agent skills, MCP integrations that expose repository, schema, and design-system context directly to tooling, and pre-commit gates that enforce formatting, type checking, linting, and tests.

Establish and enforce a consistent engineering standard across every project: strict TypeScript, schema validation at the boundaries, co-located unit and integration coverage, referential-integrity checks in CI, and single-command quality gates run before any handoff.

Ship cross-platform from single codebases, targeting web, iOS, Android, and desktop where a product warrants it, and deploy static and edge-rendered sites with image optimization and Core Web Vitals budgets in place.

Use the practice as a proving ground for emerging tooling ahead of client adoption, evaluating new runtimes, linters, build systems, rendering models, and agentic workflows, and forming grounded opinions on what earns a place in production.
Integrate LLM capability into product surfaces, covering streaming responses, structured output, tool use, and retrieval, with attention to perceived performance, graceful degradation, and cost.

Owned the frontend architecture and delivery of an AI-assisted search experience on a national news property, integrating an in-house model API, streaming responses into the UI, and optimizing perceived performance so results felt instant despite model latency.

Developed interactive React components integrated with a proprietary CMS on a consumer news property serving millions of monthly readers, improving reader engagement and streamlining editorial workflows.
Built a Storybook-based design system for React components, strengthening consistency and team collaboration.

Drove adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, embedding tools like Claude Code and Cursor into daily workflows and code review with clear guardrails, raising code quality and cutting review turnaround time.
Mentored engineers through pairing, code review, and architecture discussions, and helped set frontend standards adopted across teams.
Improved frontend maintainability through targeted refactoring and expanded unit test coverage.
Integrated Sentry.io error monitoring into the frontend stack, surfacing production issues in real time and reducing time-to-resolution on reader-facing bugs.
Partnered with product, design, editorial, and backend teams to ship reader-facing features on schedule across high-traffic surfaces.
Serve as the sole full-stack developer for two Next.js/React/Prisma/Sanity news sites (iPolitics and QP Briefing), owning the frontend, backend, CI/CD, and infrastructure end-to-end.
Diagnosed and resolved Sanity.io CMS issues, keeping both newsrooms publishing without interruption.
Led a tiered TypeScript migration of both codebases, backed by Vitest test coverage.
Implemented TanStack Query, Zustand, and Zod for data fetching, global state, and schema validation across a consistent, well-organized React codebase.
Led the conversion of a legacy React JavaScript application into modular TypeScript micro-frontends, modernizing the architecture and enabling independent deployments.
Migrated global state from Redux to Zustand and refactored components to modern React patterns, improving performance and reducing complexity.
Designed and implemented a CI/CD pipeline with automated linting, formatting, unit, and E2E tests, accelerating development cycles.
Championed TypeScript and React best practices through code reviews and updated team standards, elevating code quality.

Delivered the complete real estate platform to market in under one year.

Maintained a Lerna-managed monorepo to coordinate versioning and dependency management across packages.
Curated a Storybook-driven design system, organizing themes and themeable components to ensure visual consistency at scale.
Engineered a real-time equities trading interface on React Hooks, TypeScript, and RxJS, modelling live market data as reactive streams with predictable update and cancellation behaviour.
Authored comprehensive unit coverage across React components to protect correctness and stability in a low-latency, high-consequence environment.
Established team code quality standards, integrating ESLint and Prettier into the development workflow and enforcing them automatically.
Strengthened the DevOps pipeline with additional automated checks, accelerating builds and raising deployment confidence.
Led frontend development on an internal administration platform, planning and delivering user-management capability end to end.
Migrated the application from a legacy React architecture to a modern hooks-based architecture, reducing complexity and easing ongoing feature delivery.
Improved measured and perceived performance through webpack chunking, lazy loading, and in-memory caching of frequently accessed data.
